About.Title: About OODD CrossPrint
About.Description: CrossPrint is the cross-platform print template component by OODD. A SkiaSharp rendering core plus thin UI-host adapters cover Avalonia, WPF, WinForms, WinUI, Eto.Forms, Uno, MAUI, and a .NET WebAssembly online demo.
